class.name: BoxContainer
class.brief_description: A container that arranges its child controls horizontally or vertically.
class.description: A container that arranges its child controls horizontally or vertically, rearranging them automatically when their minimum size changes.

method.name: add_spacer
method.description: Adds a [Control] node to the box as a spacer. If [param begin] is [code]true[/code], it will insert the [Control] node in front of all other children.

members.member: The alignment of the container's children (must be one of [constant ALIGNMENT_BEGIN], [constant ALIGNMENT_CENTER], or [constant ALIGNMENT_END]).

开启后，容器计算自身最小尺寸时会使用每个可见子控件的期望内容尺寸，而不是它们的最小尺寸。这样当子控件的内容（例如 [Label] 的文本、图标或字体大小）变化时，[VBoxContainer] / [HBoxContainer] 会向父容器申请足够空间，让子控件按自身内容完整显示，同时仍然遵守每个子控件自己的 Container Sizing（size flags）：带 [constant Control.SIZE_EXPAND] 或 [constant Control.SIZE_FILL] 的子控件仍会占用多余空间，其余子控件仍按各自内容尺寸分配。 [theme_item separation] 保持原数值不变；开启或关闭开关、以及子控件内容尺寸变化时，容器会自动重新计算最小尺寸并重排子元素，间隔距离也会随新的布局位置重新计算。该开关适合放在 [ScrollContainer] 等父容器中，用于让纵向列表随内容自动伸缩。

相邻可见子控件之间在交叉轴上的偏移量，单位为像素。[VBoxContainer] 中第一项保持原位，后续项逐项水平偏移；[HBoxContainer] 中则逐项垂直偏移。正值沿交叉轴正方向排列，负值沿反方向排列，可用于让滚动列表的元素呈斜向分布，同时保持每个元素自身不变形。 容器会把所有偏移占用的范围计入最小尺寸，并缩小每个子控件在交叉轴上的可用尺寸，因此鼠标命中和焦点区域会与显示位置一致。隐藏的子控件不参与偏移序号计算。当该容器作为 [ScrollContainer] 的直接内容控件时，滚动容器会连续补偿滚动造成的交叉轴位移，使列表在可视区域内保持固定的倾斜程度；补偿只改变元素变换，不改变容器的布局尺寸。
If [code]true[/code], the [BoxContainer] will arrange its children vertically, rather than horizontally. Can't be changed when using [HBoxContainer] and [VBoxContainer].

constants.constant: The child controls will be arranged at the beginning of the container, i.e. top if orientation is vertical, left if orientation is horizontal (right for RTL layout).
The child controls will be centered in the container.
The child controls will be arranged at the end of the container, i.e. bottom if orientation is vertical, right if orientation is horizontal (left for RTL layout).

theme_items.theme_item: The space between the [BoxContainer]'s elements, in pixels.
